label: mobile-biography
invocation: async (page) => { const b=page.locator(".profile-biography"),g=page.locator(".profile-bio-chart .profile-score-histogram"); const br=await b.boundingBox(),gr=await g.boundingBox(); const checks={bioAboveGraph:br.y+br.height<=gr.y+1,noOverflow:await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1),debateLinked:await page.locator("a[href=\"/debate/sharpton-hitchens-god-religion-morality-2007/\"]").count()>0,sourceLinked:await b.locator("a[href=\"https://nationactionnetwork.squarespace.com/bio\"]").count()===1}; await b.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(); await page.screenshot({path:"output/playwright/standalone-debate-v1/debate-261/mobile-biography.png"}); if(Object.values(checks).some(v=>v!==true))throw new Error(JSON.stringify(checks)); return {checks,biography:await b.textContent(),bioBounds:br,graphBounds:gr}; }
